cases.expectation: QueryBuilderCases.readNote reads note through a proven Repository<Note> root and getOne terminal.
A uniquely assigned method-local builder retains its Note root through getMany.
The explicit entity root and join prove READ note and READ audit_log.
Insert, update, and delete execute terminals each prove WRITE note with their builder state.
CustomRepository.createQueryBuilder produces no TypeORM table fact.
getSql inspects generated SQL and creates no executed table-access fact.
A union of TypeORM Repository and custom repository is not selected arbitrarily.
The root note read is provable but note.comments adds no joined-table fact without relation metadata.
A callback source crosses the first builder-flow boundary and creates an explicit diagnostic.
A QueryBuilder CTE body is not parsed by the QueryBuilder rule.
Conditional builder reassignment prevents a resolved builder flow.
